author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
Dear Avicus Staff,

I know I have had a lot of chances and I haven't shown that I use them well but I know for certain I only need this 1 chance to show you that I can be trusted. This would mean so much to me but I really know I can make it worth it. Please see that I can really show you that I will make the most of this chance that you could grant me. I promise on my life that I will not make another i friction if you give me this chance.

I really hope you take this onboard,

regards,
DaCrowMan
